body:
### 中文更新日志
* **重要升级提醒**：本次新增「私密相册」完整服务端隔离与鉴权能力，**如需使用私密相册功能，请同步更新 Unraid 端相册容器（`easy-unraid-photos`）至最新版本**。
* **全新「苹果白金轻盈」双端视觉与大屏工作台重塑**：
  * **仪表盘重构**：采用去硬边框纯白柔影视觉语言，接入 Unraid 原版 76 款机箱矢量图标库与 4 款 3D 预设，支持与 Unraid WebUI 机箱外观一比一同步；大屏端重构全高固定侧边栏，统一仪表盘宫格角标语义仅在 Docker 有更新时显示，同步修复实时网络速率单位在小屏下的截断问题；
  * **Docker 与虚拟机大屏升级**：Docker 页融合三层轻盈卡片与 OrbStack 高密度 6 列列表双视图，分离启停按钮与开机自启动开关消除语义混淆；Docker 容器管控中心与虚拟机管控中心在大屏端重构为居中左右双栏面板，一屏直达全部监控指标与运维入口；
  * **Docker 实时流式更新与后端三层更新提醒**：容器更新升级为实时按层展示下载字节、层数与阶段的平滑进度条，支持后台防重冲突与顶部常驻续接横幅、管控中心原位检测与更新加载反馈；冷启动自动检测智能相册与智能中枢后端容器新版本，在导航栏、设置入口及置顶系统环境卡片中一键直达更新；
  * **全应用大屏悬浮窗与硬件详情双栏**：大屏端所有核心面板与配置弹窗统一升级为居中圆角悬浮模态窗；CPU、内存、UPS、GPU、网络接口与系统核心服务 6 大硬件详情窗重构为大屏双栏/多列布局，GPU 核心负载升级为按卡独立记录的 24 点实时历史趋势曲线；
  * **智能中枢 UI 全面统一**：中枢首页接入真实硬件时序采样波形，服务健康哨兵、硬件时序看板、网络质量测速、AI 弹幕同传工作台在大屏端升级为多列/左右双栏工作台。
* **Docker、Compose 与应用商店全面对齐 Unraid 原生体验**：
  * **新建与编辑容器深度对齐 WebUI**：支持从宿主机已有用户模版快速载入、编辑容器复用本地已有镜像免重复拉取、自动过滤镜像内置默认环境变量，部署时自动补注宿主机 `TZ`、`HOST_OS`、`HOST_HOSTNAME`、`HOST_CONTAINERNAME` 标准变量与流式拉取进度；
  * **零侵入 Docker Compose v2 编排升级**：升级至 Compose v2 引擎（宿主机未装插件时自动通过官方 `docker:cli` 临时容器零侵入执行），新增 `docker-compose.yml` 与 `.env` 双标签代码编辑、全套桌面快捷键（`Cmd/Ctrl+V/C/X/A/Z/S`）与一键粘贴、堆栈实时日志、拉取更新重建及「可更新」状态与宿主机缓存双向联动；
  * **应用商店 `.plg` 插件安装升级**：插件安装与覆盖更新升级为实时流式终端输出、严格退出码校验，并在完成后自动刷新插件列表与商店已安装状态。
* **虚拟机全链路创建编辑与运行态保护**：
  * 全面对齐 Unraid 原生虚拟机创建/编辑全量参数与双端白金布局，支持运行中/暂停虚拟机进入硬件与 XML 只读查看模式并禁止保存修改，杜绝误改配置。
* **智能相册「私密相册」全链路闭环**：
  * 支持原文件无损隐藏隔离、独立 Vault Token 硬鉴权与防窥模糊锁，与 AI 聚类、宝宝相册、回收站及本地缓存完全物理隔离；
  * 支持按日期分组时间轴、照片/视频筛选、按日勾选、大屏拖拽直传与双端响应式适配；
  * 统一相册缩略图桌面悬停微放大、Hero 转场，并彻底修复开启批量选择时因动画曲线嵌套过冲引发的全端 Release 卡死问题。
* **文件管理器全格式预览、离线办公与在线智能解压**：
  * **纯客户端离线 Office 套件**：新增 Word / Excel / PPT / CSV 离线预览与安全编辑能力，支持桌面端调用本机软件编辑后自动回传；
  * **在线智能解压与格式兼容**：新增单目录防套娃、多文件自动建同名文件夹、前台解压自动进入目录与后台运行完成快捷跳转，并为 RAR / 7Z 解压和预览补齐 Unraid 原生 `bsdtar` 自动回退与安全转义；
  * **阅读体验与隐藏文件优化**：内置 PDF 预览器启用原生力度惯性滚动并新增右侧悬浮页码抓手；长文本预览支持 GBK/UTF-16 自动编码识别与右侧快速滑动抓手；优化显示隐藏文件瞬时切换动效并修复 Android 端 Office 预览返回掉帧；
  * **SFTP 极速引擎与四端硬件视频抽帧**：优化单 RTT 列目录、持久化 SWR 快照与骨架屏，消除桌面端 300ms 点击延迟；补齐 Android / iOS / macOS / Windows 四端纯客户端视频硬件按需抽帧与 Rust `native_sftp` 全四端二进制同步更新；统一文件管理响应断点至 `800px` 消除 iPad 竖屏触发旧版抽屉的断层；侧边栏与移动端快捷入口统一升级为「配置目录（`/boot/config`）」。
* **全站交互精雕、合规与稳定性加固**：
  * 统一全站桌面端按钮悬停与按压弹性反馈组件 `DesktopHoverSurface`、650ms 精致胶囊 Tooltip 及双端自适应浮动通知横条 `AppToast`；补齐系统通知归档与批量操作的原位微动效；
  * 彻底移除移动端底部弹窗 `DraggableScrollableSheet` 消除列表下滑半路悬停与手势冲突；修复 iOS `Info.plist` 定位权限描述以通过 App Store 二进制合规校验；
  * 加固云端多机授权状态同步、冷启动防串权与离线缓存逻辑，修复官方支持弹窗历史消息跳动回弹与 macOS 浏览器拉起回退。

### English Changelog
* **Important Upgrade Notice**: This release introduces full server-side isolation and authentication for Private Vault. **Please update your `easy-unraid-photos` container on Unraid to the latest version** to enable Private Vault features.
* **Apple Platinum Light Redesign & Desktop Split-Pane Workspaces**:
  * **Dashboard Overhaul**: Adopted a borderless soft-shadow Apple Platinum visual language with Unraid's native 76-icon chassis font and 4 built-in 3D presets synchronized 1:1 with Unraid WebUI; rebuilt desktop full-height pinned navigation rail, unified dashboard tile badge semantics for Docker updates, and resolved mobile network rate unit truncation;
  * **Docker & VM Desktop Upgrade**: Combined three-layer cards with a high-density 6-column OrbStack table view in Docker, decoupled power controls from autostart toggles, and redesigned both Docker Container and VM Control Centers into zero-scroll split-pane floating dialogs on desktop;
  * **Real-Time Streaming Docker Pull & Backend Update Badges**: Upgraded container updates with real-time per-layer download byte/phase progress, duplicate-run protection, and an auto-reattaching background progress banner; added cold-start three-layer update badges and top settings update cards for Photos and Hub backend containers;
  * **Unified Desktop Floating Modals & Hardware Inspectors**: Automatically adapted core sheets and utility modals into centered floating windows on wide screens (`>= 800px`), redesigned CPU, Memory, UPS, GPU, Network, and Core Services detail panels into dual-column desktop views, and upgraded GPU core load to a per-PCI 24-point real-time waveform;
  * **Smart Hub UI Unification**: Connected real-time telemetry sparklines to Hub Home and upgraded Health Sentinel, Metrics Monitor, Network Speedtest, and AI Live Caption Studio to desktop multi-column/split-pane workspaces.
* **Docker, Compose & CA Store Alignment with Unraid WebUI**:
  * **Native Docker Create & Edit Parity**: Added host user template loading, local image reuse without redundant pulls when editing unchanged repositories, Dockerfile default env filtering, and automatic injection of standard Unraid host env vars (`TZ`, `HOST_OS`, `HOST_HOSTNAME`, `HOST_CONTAINERNAME`) with streaming pull progress;
  * **Zero-Intrusion Docker Compose v2**: Upgraded engine to Compose v2 (auto-detecting native `docker compose` or zero-intrusion official `docker:cli compose`), added dual-tab `docker-compose.yml` + `.env` editing, full desktop keyboard shortcuts (`Cmd/Ctrl+V/C/X/A/Z/S`) with one-click paste, stack runtime logs, `pull & up` rebuilds, and synchronized update badges with host cache refresh;
  * **Streaming CA Store Plugin Installer**: Upgraded `.plg` plugin installation and forced updates to live streaming terminal logs with strict exit-code verification and automatic installed-state refresh.
* **VM Creation, Editing & Running-State Protection**:
  * Aligned VM creation and editing parameters with Unraid WebUI in a dual-platform Platinum layout, and added read-only hardware & XML inspection mode for running/paused VMs to prevent accidental changes.
* **Private Vault End-to-End Pipeline**:
  * Added lossless hidden-storage isolation, dedicated Vault Token authentication, and privacy blur lock completely isolated from AI clustering, Baby Album, Trash, and local caches;
  * Supported date-grouped timelines, photo/video filters, desktop drag-and-drop direct import, hover zoom & Hero transitions, and fixed a critical Release-mode UI freeze caused by nested overshooting animation curves when entering batch selection.
* **File Manager Offline Office Suite, Smart Extract & High-Speed Engine**:
  * **Client-Side Offline Office Suite**: Added offline preview and safe editing for Word, Excel, PPT, and CSV files, including automatic sync-back after desktop native editing;
  * **Smart Online Extraction & Archive Fallback**: Added smart extraction (preventing double-nested single folders, auto-wrapping multi-file roots, auto-opening extracted folders, and background completion quick-jump) plus Unraid native `bsdtar` fallback and safe quoting for RAR/7Z archives;
  * **Enhanced Readers & Hidden File Toggle**: Enabled native momentum scrolling and floating page scrubber for PDFs, GBK/UTF-16 auto-detection and fast scrollbar for text files, smooth hidden-files toggle animation, and smooth back-navigation transitions for Android Office previews;
  * **SFTP Turbo & 4-Platform Hardware Video Thumbnails**: Added single-RTT directory listing, SWR snapshots, 0ms desktop selection, unified `800px` responsive breakpoint eliminating the legacy iPad portrait drawer, and cross-platform on-demand hardware video frame extraction across Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows with updated Rust `native_sftp` binaries.
* **Cross-Platform Polish, Compliance & Licensing Hardening**:
  * Unified desktop hover/press feedback (`DesktopHoverSurface`), 650ms capsule tooltips, responsive floating `AppToast` notifications, and in-place notification archive micro-animations;
  * Removed `DraggableScrollableSheet` on mobile bottom sheets to eliminate scroll-vs-drag gesture conflicts; restored iOS `Info.plist` location usage descriptions for App Store binary compliance (`ITMS-90683`);
  * Hardened multi-server license sync, cold-start isolation, support chat scroll anchoring, macOS external URL fallback, and dozens of cross-platform audit fixes.
